title: Weekly Cut-List Runs and How Far a Signature Missed the Window
content:
The plant runs its cut lists weekly, on a Friday. For Factory Production Orders, cut-list regeneration adds business days to the late-acknowledgment shift by how far the signature date itself missed the window, taken as the business days from the day after the window closes up to and including the signature date:

- when it missed by **more than 5** such business days, the order waits for the plant's next weekly cut-list run on a Friday and adds the business days from the day after the signature date up to and including the first Friday after the signature date;
- when it missed by **3 to 5**, it adds **1 business day**;
- when it missed by **fewer than 3**, it adds nothing.

Business days are Monday through Friday, excluding U.S. federal holidays. The days are added to the late-acknowledgment shift as whole business days before the late-acknowledgment revised ship date is counted. The miss is always measured to the signature date itself.

## Bands on both sides

| Business days the signature missed the window by | Days added |
|---|---|
| 1 or 2 | none |
| 3 | 1 |
| 5 | 1 |
| 6 or more | business days from the day after the signature date through the first Friday after it |

## The first Friday after the signature date

The first Friday after the signature date is the next Friday strictly after it: a signature on a Wednesday looks to the Friday two days later; a signature on a Friday looks to the Friday a week later. Only business days in that stretch are added, so a U.S. federal holiday falling in it is not counted.

## Hypothetical cases (no federal holiday in the period)

- Missed by 7 business days, signed on a Wednesday: the Thursday and the Friday after it are added, 2 business days.
- Missed by 8 business days, signed on a Friday: Monday through Friday of the following week are added, 5 business days.
- Missed by 4 business days: 1 business day.
